questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. No Flower is Plant.

II. Some Animal are Flower.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some Animal are not Plant.

II. All Plant are Animal.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7621e1f93d8e238caada6310c1697cc98a31df792721f6eca69a7b1984521d0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Animal are not Plant → Follow (As no Flower is Plant and some Animal are Flower. As Bananas cannot be cherries which whole comes in litchis, therefore it is true.)

(II) All Plant are Animal → Does not follow (As no Flower is Plant and some Animal are Flower. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Six teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa and Rohit are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Abhi is second to the left of Heena. Rohit is third to the right of Heena. Gopal is second to the right of Jatin. Rohit is second to the left of Jatin. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Abhi?
questions.solution:
Given: Six teachers Jatin, Abhi, Gopal, Heena, Ishaa and Rohit are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

1) Abhi is second to the left of Heena.

2) Rohit is third to the right of Heena.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f3017bb49762eabdf2be44d19346b61e38a425a672724b5dafd16e63e7d8de8.png] 

3) Rohit is second to the left of Jatin.

4) Gopal is second to the right of Jatin.

After positioning Rohit and Jatin only one position is left which will be occupied by the only teacher left i.e. Ishaa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94c949ee88cf9e66463933e7e7a49b3750917303a37d959c81047fbd68a06503.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement **Jatin** sits to the immediate right of Abhi.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which one set of letters when sequentially placed at the gaps in the given letter series shall complete it?

_n_mn_m_wmnw
questions.solution:
Given series: _n_mn_m_wmnw

Option 1) wmnw→ __w__n__m__mn__n__m__w__wmnw → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) mwwn → __**m**__n__**w**__mn__**w**__m__**n**__wmnw → (It follows the pattern of: mnw - mnw - mnw - mnw)

Option 3) mnwn → __m__n__n__mn__w__m__n__wmnw → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) mmwn → __m__n__m__mn__w__m__n__wmnw → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A + B means A is the wife of B, A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B, A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B. 

If Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B, then how is H related to S ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 ×
 ÷
 $
 -
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Father
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

Given: Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B

Z - T → Z is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ae0134fe555f311534a90f8bb97529710db2a182930d90b67fca63af7c1a800.png] 

T ÷ S → T is the mother of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/407afcbdc3b11332a95235598a8be32a1960da537116e4366cb1fd5adc53d561.png] 

S × Y → S is the father of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99b1b07be6e71c261fd46b65f4e85e212bbe0708aa428ff118e1ac7bfffdac70.png] 

Y + H → Y is the wife of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1f729bd313688db2d199092b0a73068e8c9273fcfe1746052021e8beafdda69.png] 

H $ B → H is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d49d0a88124df72a31bb0ad3374da4d2ae6d9ac0c0b6c842c76ad0f76432d91.png] 

Thus, H is S's son-in-law or daughter's husband.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"

questions.question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing '1' on it ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6f37d0d80fbdd5df5765bd7fe19e74669bb3b7aebea132108434c5cbf1f6d97.png]
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As & is common on both the dices, it is clear that 2, #, 1, and 8 are adjacent to it, and the remaining will be opposite to it.

Opposite pairs: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ecbd3703e4c926251237c08e8cb537c35a8bdbd731739e5252eca1280968f7f.png] 

# → 8

2 → 1

So, the opposite side of "1" will be side "2".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

4 → 3

So, the opposite side of "4" will be side "3".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
